text.p: Australian bond yields underperformed against other dollar bloc bonds after the release of the third quarter capital expenditure report dented hopes of an imminent cut in domestic interest rates.

Before the data, which was stronger than expected, the Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread briefly broke resistance at 90 basis points to near the mid-80's, a level not seen in almost a month, traders said.

Meanwhile, U.S. Treasuries showed an easier bias in Tokyo, continuing Friday's New York trend, as the market adjusted positions ahead of Thursday's Thanksgiving Day holiday and a host of economic data.
The local market also underperformed Canadian bonds, which outpaced the U.S. on Friday, while New Zealand debt rallied slightly in thin trading.
